title: Expired first patent and a new second patent (raised by Flint Dibble)

tellings.quote: Yes, my initial patent at the moment is expired.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a researcher who claims to have found a vast energy grid beneath the pyramids of Egypt, tells Michels that his first patent, filed with the US patent office, "at the moment is expired," and that he has a newer second patent. He is answering a point raised in a video by a critic named Flint Dibble, and he speaks from his own knowledge of his filings.
